fields.statement: Fix the headless-run-agent-tabs flake in its fixture, not by quarantine: the fake bin/claude builder retries its git add and git commit while the shared run worktree's index is locked by concurrent git work, as a real agent would; the two CI symptoms of PRs #513 and #593 are already fixed (verifier-verdict-reads-fresh-model, and commitOnly's HEAD-moved retry from PR #595), and the index.lock race is the one that still reproduces at main
fields.wording: Fix the fixture's index.lock race; do not quarantine. Planner's ruling in an autonomous plan run, from the reproduction

fields.acceptance: Every go test below runs inside systemd-run --user --scope --quiet -p MemoryMax=6G -p TasksMax=300 with -p 2 and RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_* unset, one at a time. (1) go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=30 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^headless-run-agent-tabs$' passes; before the fix the same command failed about once in 15 to 20 runs with 'attempt 1 builder ... fail (exit 1)' and 'Unable to create ... index.lock: File exists' in $WORK/panes.out. (2) (failure case) With a temporary scratch edit, not committed, that makes the fake rex create $WORK/repo/.git/worktrees/repo.built/index.lock before it starts a builder's pane and remove it about 0.3 s later in the background, the script fails once with the old fake builder (the builder exits 1 on the lock) and passes once with the new one; the commit's Checks: block records both runs. (3) Every existing assertion of the script still holds unchanged.
fields.must_not: Change any Go code (internal/ or cmd/rhiza/*.go); drop, loosen or reorder any assertion of the script; skip or quarantine the script; edit other scripts' fake builders; use busy loops, CPU stress or parallel stress runs to reproduce
fields.statement: In cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/headless-run-agent-tabs.txtar, the fake bin/claude builder retries its git add and git commit of the leaf file (a bounded loop of short sleeps, about 5 s in all, then exit 1) while either fails, so a sibling's or the runner's hold on the shared run worktree's index.lock no longer fails a builder attempt, and the script's header comment says why
